news.title: Meet the Press NOW — July 28
news.description: A solemn day in Washington as President Trump and world leaders attend the late Senator Lindsey Graham’s funeral. Documentary filmmaker Alex Holder spent over four years with Senator Lindsey Graham right until his death and shares never-before-seen footage with Meet the Press NOW. In Michigan, Congresswoman Haley Stevens (D-Mich.) and Abdul El-Sayed (D) had their final debate last night in the closely watched race, with just one week to go before the primary.

news.title: ‘I’m tired’: Lindsey Graham in never-before-seen video as he tried to secure deal to end Ukraine war
news.description: Meet the Press moderator Kristen Welker sits down with documentary filmmaker Alex Holder who spent more four years following Senator Graham right until his death. Holder shares never-before-seen footage of Senator Graham raising concerns about “war fatigue” in Ukraine and a conversation between Lindsey and his sister Darline Graham about his entry into politics.

news.title: Netanyahu & Zelenskyy attend Graham funeral as wars in Iran and Ukraine reach critical points
news.description: President Trump, lawmakers, and world leaders attend Sen. Lindsey Graham’s funeral as policymakers try to navigate a path forward in the wars in Iran and Ukraine. NBC News correspondents Monica Alba, Matt Bradley, and Courtney Kube report on the latest developments. Elise Labott, host of the Cosmopolitics podcast, discusses where the U.S. stands in the Iran War as it enters its sixth month and the administration’s evolving relationship with Ukraine's President Zelenskyy.
